scope: Steady EPANET 2.2 water graph, D-W friction, fixed head sources and fixed-speed sourced head curves; static pressure head only

pump efficiency/power, NPSH, controls, tanks/time variation and water quality
domain-specific water/fire rules and full engineering acceptance

source_data.name: Saved IFC spatial water-ring hydraulic template
source_data.pressure_basis: static pressure head in metres of water; head is elevation plus static pressure head
source_data.coordinate_basis: schematic diagram coordinates; not physical routes

sources.test: Synthetic connected water loop for EPANET verification; explicit route dimensions, boundary heads, design withdrawals, global pressure law and limits. Not measured building geometry or code/product data.
sources.pump: Synthetic fixed-speed two-or-multi-point head curve in metres at given m3/s; no manufacturer, efficiency, operating-region or NPSH claim.
sources.solver: Explicit numerical convergence/QA tolerances and runtime budget for this synthetic model. Velocity cross-check tolerance 0.0001 m/s accounts for EPANET legacy LPSperCFS=28.317 versus exact SI conversion and binary output precision; it does not relax the physical velocity limit. Reference: https://github.com/OpenWaterAnalytics/EPANET/blob/v2.2/src/types.h Energy QA allowance is 0.0001 m plus 0.00001 times the greater absolute model/observed drop, for native float output and input serialization; not physical design margin. Independent audit uses EPANET 2.2 engine gravity, reference viscosity, Swamee-Jain/Dunlop and legacy conversion conventions: https://usepa.github.io/EPANET2.2/12_analysis_algorithms.html and https://github.com/OpenWaterAnalytics/EPANET/blob/v2.2/src/hydcoeffs.c
